text:
ashley: quick heads-up — landing fused-kernel patch (PR #482). planning a canary on canary-3 for small-batch + mixed-seq workloads. need a couple of microbench runs and nvtx traces. who can take this?

matt: I can run it. is this FlashAttention2 only or are we toggling paged-attn too?

ashley: primary variant = flash2 + fused-op chain. secondary variant = flash2 + paged-attn (for fallback comparison). want mixed seq lengths 8/64/512 and a bursty small-batch profile (batch sizes 1, 2, 4).

olivia: i'll kick off bench harness on canary-3. capturing p50/p95/p99, GPU util, and kv-cache eviction markers. ETA ~25m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ashley: awesome. config to use (copy/paste):

```
bench_run --env=canary-3 --model=gpt-8b --variants=flash2,fused,paged-b
  --cases=seq8,seq64,seq512 --batches=1,2,4 --iters=1200 --seed=42 \
  --profile=nvtx,flamegraph --output=bench-PR482.json
```

ricardo: reminder: pin CUDA toolkit to 12.1 on canary-3 machines. last week we saw a driver fallback that changed kernel selection.

dina: will set autoscale min=1 to avoid cold-start noise during the run. also watching queue length.

matt: quick FYI from a dry run on my laptop: saw ~7% p99 regress on batch=1 for fused-op chain vs baseline (no-fuse). need to check whether it's kernel scheduling or KV path.

ashley: if regression >5% on p99 we hold the canary. capture step-level histograms (`trace_step_hist`) so we can localize slow steps.

olivia: bench-bot just queued the job. job id=2026-1763010150. results URL: https://benchboard.redwood/job/2026-1763010150

bench-bot: job 2026-1763010150 started on canary-3 (node=gpu-c3-4). logs streaming to s3://redwood-bench/canary/PR482/2026-1763010150.log

matt: i'll add an extra sweep toggling `USE_QUANT_KERNEL=0` vs `1` to see impact. will also run with `DEBUG_NVPROF=1` for one short iteration to get kernel timeline.

olivia: first quick numbers (warm cache, batch=1): baseline p50=11.8ms p99=78ms; fused PR p50=12.4ms p99=85ms; throughput -4.5%. full traces uploading, flamegraph link in benchboard.

ashley: thanks. matt — can you grab a micro gdb trace on the slow step (around step 482 reported in flamegraph) and check for kernel fallback / extra memcpy?

matt: on it, running `gdb --batch -x scripts/microtrace.gdb --args ./infer ...` now. will paste clipped logs.

ricardo: I also kicked a node-level perf sample to check host-side stalls (irq/context-switch) just in case.

dina: if we see >5% p99 regression at the 30m check, i'll flip canary off and notify infra.

olivia: uploaded nvtx bundle and trace snippet. flamegraph shows one heavy kernel at ~1.2ms increased occupancy for fused path. attaching small excerpt: 

```
p50: 12.4ms
p95: 39.7ms
p99: 85.3ms
throughput: 95.5 t/s (baseline 100.1 t/s)
hot-kernel: fused_attn_kernel_v3 (avg 1.8ms -> 3.0ms on some steps)
```

ashley: good. matt / ricardo — can you correlate that hot kernel name to the kernel build flags? if it's falling back to a slower variant we need to adjust the kernel selector heuristics.

matt: quick grep in build artifacts shows fused_attn_kernel_v3 was compiled with `-march=sm86 -O3` but nvprof trace indicates a fallback path `fused_attn_generic` invoked for sequence-length=8. likely selector bug.

ashley: ok that's actionable. if it's selector fallback for short seqs, we can either special-case seq<=16 to use the old kernel or fix selector. for canary hold threshold at 5% — unless olivia sees a clear memory/eviction cause.

olivia: memory graphs look clean, no extra evictions. looks like selector picks wrong kernel for short sequences.

matt: opening PR to force kernel for seq<=16 to legacy fused path and re-run the smoke. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/498

ashley: perfect. once matt posts new numbers we'll re-evaluate. thanks all. :clap:
